subject: Edge tooling RFP — shortlist & PoC candidates
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Ethan Ross <eross@cloudflare.com>, Sophie Martin <sophie@fastly.com>, Diego Morales <diego@akamai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Edge tooling RFP — pricing baseline & migration window

Hi all,

Thanks for joining the informal vendor ask — we're about to publish the final RFP to internal teams and need updated, line-item proposals by COB next Tuesday (10/5). Key asks:

- Firm pricing for 12- and 24-month commitments (list token/egress assumptions).
- Any available migration credits or implementation discounts.
- SLA differences (latency p95, availability) and security add-ons (WAF rulesets, bot management).
- Typical migration timeline for an org our size (peak traffic profile attached).

I attached the current RFP draft and a costing worksheet (edge-costing-worksheet.xlsx) — those contain our baseline traffic assumptions. Please highlight any hard exclusions (e.g., egress pass-through charges, third-party licenses).

We plan to pick two vendors for an in-depth PoC/benchmarks phase (2–3 weeks each) and would like costed PoC scopes if possible. If you need a short discovery call this week, flag your availability.

Thanks — appreciate straight-line pricing and any one-time migration incentives.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Platform & Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rfp-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
Attachment: edge-costing-worksheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Ethan Ross <eross@cloudflare.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge tooling RFP — pricing baseline & migration window

Laura — thanks for the clear ask. High level reply: Cloudflare can provide two commercial options that fit your objectives. Summary here and I'll attach a filled worksheet.

Option A (12-month): 15% discount off list, includes 2 weeks implementation support (no-cost), estimated savings on egress via Argo Smart Routing for common flows.
Option B (24-month): 25% discount off list, includes 4 weeks onboarding + one migration credit equal to one month of baseline usage.

SLA: 99.95% standard, with an enterprise SLA of 99.99% available under a dedicated contract. WAF: Managed ruleset included; advanced bot management is an add-on.

PoC: We can scope a 3-week PoC focused on request/response latency and origin offload. We'll provide telemetry and a short-run synthetic script for apples-to-apples.

I'll attach the worksheet and a short one-pager. If it's helpful I can do a 30-minute sync tomorrow at 10:00 PT.

—Ethan
Ethan Ross
Partnerships, Cloudflare

Attachment: cloudflare-edge-proposal.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sophie Martin <sophie@fastly.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge tooling RFP — pricing baseline & migration window

Laura / team — appreciate the RFP. Fastly's short answer: we can beat certain egress patterns (origin shielding + POP-level caching), and we recommend testing origin compute for heavy inference paths.

Pricing: modular — edge delivery + WAF + image/compute are quoted separately. Typical commercial structures: 20% off list with a 12-month commit; 30% off list with 24-months and an implementation credit. Egress: we can provide a blended egress tier if most traffic concentrates in a few regions.

Timeline: conservative 4–6 weeks to fully onboard and validate routing rules across services; PoC can be 2 weeks focusing on p95 latency and cache hit improvements.

Would like to propose a short trial for a single customer segment (low-risk) so we can show measurable cost/perf delta.

—Sophie
Sophie Martin
Enterprise Sales, Fastly

Attachment: fastly-rfp-response.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Diego Morales <diego@akamai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge tooling RFP — pricing baseline & migration window

Laura — thanks for including Akamai. We're prepared to offer a full enterprise package: WAF, CDN, and advanced bot mitigation in a single SKU. Key points:

- SLA/hardware: global footprint with added DDoS protection and 24/7 SOC support.
- Pricing: typically higher list but discounts meaningful with multiyear commitments and added security bundles.
- Migration: recommend a staged cutover with traffic steering (3–6 weeks).

We can provide a draft scope for a PoC focused on security posture (WAF rule efficacy and false-positive rates) and a separate perf PoC if you'd like. Happy to hop on a 30-min call Friday to review line items.

Regards,
Diego Morales
Solutions Architect, Akamai

Attachment: akamai-enterprise-quote.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge tooling RFP — pricing baseline & migration window

Team — quick internal note after scanning vendor replies: they differ materially on how they treat egress and PoC scope. Ask to Procurement: can we get a one-page comparison (total cost of ownership over 12 & 24 months, PoC cost estimates, migration window) by EOD Monday 10/5? Marcus/Vivek, can you model the blended egress scenarios from the worksheet and surface sensitivity to 10/25/50% traffic offload?

Also copying ProcurePoint (procuresales@procurepoint.com) to support contract-level tradeoffs (SLA credits, termination windows). We need a narrow shortlist for two PoC partners — my initial bias is Cloudflare + Fastly for speed/cost tradeoffs, but want data.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Cloud Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: ProcurePoint Consulting <procuresales@procurepoint.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge tooling RFP — pricing baseline & migration window

Hi Marissa / team — attached is a concise one-page comparison I ran this morning (onepage-comparison.pdf). High level notes:

- Cloudflare: best migration incentives and simplest PoC telemetry; slightly higher egress risk depending on uncommon flows.
- Fastly: strong caching primitives that reduce egress in our model; needs more work to collapse WAF + delivery SKUs.
- Akamai: strongest security posture and enterprise SLAs, but higher baseline cost and longer cutover.

I've also included two approaches to contract language that preserve a 30-day exit for PoC and explicit performance gates. Happy to talk through Monday.

—ProcurePoint (Samantha Lee)
Procurement Lead, ProcurePoint Consulting

Attachment: onepage-comparison.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, ProcurePoint Consulting <procuresales@procurepoint.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge tooling RFP — pricing baseline & migration window

Marissa — thanks for the quick steer and ProcurePoint for the comparison. Recommendation and ask:

- Shortlist for PoC: Fastly + Cloudflare (two distinct technical approaches; Fastly for cache-first, Cloudflare for integrated routing + migration credits).
- PoC scope: 2-week performance PoC (p95 latency, cache hit improvement) followed by a 2-week security validation (WAF false-positive / rule tuning) — vendors should provide telemetry and an implementation contact.
- Contract guardrails: 30-day PoC exit, explicit performance gates, and one migration credit applied to first invoice for selected vendor.

Marissa, please confirm approval to proceed with internal purchase orders and sign the standard PoC SOWs. Marcus/Vivek, please prepare the TCO slides for the exec review (one slide — delta vs. current supplier).

If approved I'll notify vendors today and request PoC start dates.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Platform & Product Operations
Redwood Inference
